caption.pl: Listing „Testy” — 100 opublikowanych artykułów liczonych dynamicznie z MDX, numerowane wiersze z marką/modelem. The small thumbnail icons in the corner are broken because gallery files are not part of this checkout (photos are stored locally, outside the repo) — everything else on the page (copy, counts, layout) is fully real.
